clause_path: Req 3.5.1 unreadable PAN approaches, 3.5.1.c correlation controls, applicability notes; Req 3.5.1.1 keyed cryptographic hashes. Ids continue the node id space (d1 ends at O7)

obligations.label: stored PAN must be rendered unreadable using one of the listed approaches, wherever it is stored
approach: one-way hashes based on strong cryptography over the entire PAN
approach: truncation, where hashing must not be used to replace the truncated segment of the PAN
when hashed and truncated versions of the same PAN, or different truncation formats of it, coexist, additional controls must make the versions impossible to correlate back to the original PAN
testing: where hashed and truncated versions of the same PAN are present, examine the implemented controls to verify they cannot be correlated to reconstruct the PAN
approach: strong cryptography with associated key management processes and procedures
the unreadability requirement covers PAN in primary storage (databases, flat files) and non-primary storage (backup, audit, exception, troubleshooting logs)
temporary files holding cleartext PAN during encryption and decryption operations do not violate the requirement
hashes used per the one-way-hash approach must be keyed cryptographic hashes of the entire PAN, with key management per Requirements 3.6 and 3.7
all applicability notes for Requirement 3.5.1 apply equally to Requirement 3.5.1.1
